concept.statement: Welcome to Éphémère. We celebrate fine ingredients prepared with precision and passion. Each dish blends innovative techniques with time-honored traditions, honoring local flavors and global inspiration. Join us for refined cuisine in an elegant, intimate setting.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Salmon
dishes.description: Atlantic salmon pan-seared to perfection with a crispy skin, served with lemon butter sauce, roasted asparagus, and herbed rice pilaf

dishes.name: Grilled Pork Chop
dishes.description: Thick-cut bone-in pork chop grilled to perfection, served with apple chutney, roasted sweet potatoes, and sautéed green beans

dishes.name: Duck Confit
dishes.description: Slow-cooked duck leg with cherry gastrique, roasted root vegetables, and thyme. Crispy skin with tender, fall-off-the-bone meat

dishes.name: Mushroom Risotto
dishes.description: Creamy arborio rice with wild mushrooms, white wine, and fresh herbs. Finished with Parmigiano-Reggiano, truffle oil, and microgreens

dishes.name: Wagyu Beef
dishes.description: Grilled A5 wagyu with truffle pommes purée, asparagus, and red wine jus. Served with roasted bone marrow and seasonal vegetables

dishes.name: Rack of Lamb
dishes.description: Herb-crusted rack of lamb with mint pesto, roasted garlic, and a red wine reduction. Served with ratatouille and creamy polenta
